tools.name: calc
tools.description: Evaluate a mathematical expression. Supports arithmetic (+, -, *, /, ^, %), parentheses, and functions (sqrt, sin, cos, tan, abs, log, ln, exp, floor, ceil, round). Constants: pi, e. Use for questions like 'what is 15% of 80', 'sqrt(144) + 5^2', or 'sin(pi/4)'.

expression.description: The mathematical expression to evaluate, e.g. '2 + 3 * 4', 'sqrt(144)', 'sin(pi/4) + cos(pi/4)'
